steps.label: Information Flag
steps.caption: Insight portal flags high risk transaction across risk strategy.

steps.label: Escapement Review
steps.caption: Officer reviews flagged data suggesting taxable income escaped.

steps.label: Prior Approval
steps.caption: Specified authority grants preliminary sanction for inquiry.

steps.label: Jurisdiction Gate
steps.caption: Proceedings advance to statutory preliminary inquiry stage.

steps.label: Preliminary Inquiry
steps.caption: Officer gathers external data with prior statutory sanction.

steps.label: Show Cause Notice
steps.caption: Assessee receives show cause notice with supporting evidence.

steps.label: Assessee Response
steps.caption: Assessee files detailed rebuttal supported by commercial records.

steps.label: Speaking Order
steps.caption: Officer passes reasoned order on fitness of reassessment.

steps.label: Standard Window
steps.caption: Three year window permits reassessment for any escaped sum.

steps.label: Extended Window
steps.caption: Ten year window requires fifty lakh rupee asset threshold.

steps.label: Asset Representation
steps.caption: Escaped income must be represented by asset or book entry.

steps.label: Statutory Sunset
steps.caption: Time barred past years cannot be revived under amended rules.

steps.label: Authority Rank
steps.caption: Higher rank approval is mandatory for notices beyond three years.

steps.label: Independent Mind
steps.caption: Sanctioning authority records independent appraisal of evidence.

steps.label: Writ Remedy
steps.caption: Defective sanction is challenged before constitutional court.

steps.label: Order Deadline
steps.caption: Reassessment order must be completed within twelve months.

steps.label: Notice Parsing
steps.caption: Engine ingests electronic notice and validates digital signature.

steps.label: Limitation Audit
steps.caption: Algorithm computes elapsed duration from assessment year end.

steps.label: Threshold Test
steps.caption: System checks whether alleged escapement meets statutory limit.

steps.label: Remedy Strategy
steps.caption: Platform recommends writ petition or substantive defense response.
